description: Stable Trading Economics market symbols + country indicators for themedata series. Resolve once (search costs API budget); do not re-search on a schedule. Batch pullable market symbols in one markets/symbol call when refreshing. Country indicators use historical/country/.../indicator/... (cached).
budget_notes: Plan: 500 REST requests/month — treat as scarce.
Weekly refresh: one batched markets/symbol for all status=pull commodity keys (~4 calls/month).
Historical: once per symbol/indicator (or incremental since last as_of); cache under data/te/cache/.
HTML scrape remains a zero-API fallback for germanium public page only.

lithium_carbonate_cny_t.name: Lithium
lithium_carbonate_cny_t.notes: China battery-grade lithium carbonate 99.5% Li2CO3 (CNY/t). LFP-creep scissors vs non-Li LDES. No vanadium TE symbol.

bh_us_total_rigs.name: US Total Rigs (Baker Hughes via TE)
bh_us_total_rigs.notes: Weekly Baker Hughes US total rotary rig count (oil+gas+misc; land+offshore) via TE.
